project.name: osgi/foundation/seed-broker-testkit
project.description: Reusable test doubles for the seed-broker seam. Chiefly RefusingCellar: a Cellar that THROWS on every access — the honest stand-in for a sow whose handler must NOT touch the cellar (a reflector's unit test), so a stray read fails loud instead of a null NPE-ing or a silent empty masking the contract breach. A plain jar (not a bundle); consumers add it in test scope.
